name: @tessera/doctor
description: EnvironmentDoctor — deterministic three-state readiness, fail-closed (PLAN Phase 1)

scripts.//test:run: `find` narrows the run to `test/**/*.test.js`: given no arguments `node --test` applies its own discovery, which also executes every other `.js` under `test/` — support and helper files — as a test file. That is also the cost: zero matches expands to nothing, `node --test` falls back to exactly that discovery and exits 0 either way, so a suite that vanished is a silent pass rather than a gate failure.
